newsitem.title: USA: NYC executive focus of L.A. transit chief search.
newsitem.headline: NYC executive focus of L.A. transit chief search.

text.p: Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority's search for a new chief executive has narrowed to New York City transit official Michael Ascher, the Los Angeles Times reported Thursday.
Members of the Los Angeles transportation agency met this week with Ascher, who is president of the Bridge and Tunnel Authority for New York City's MTA, according to the Times.
Ascher currently is the only candidate being interviewed by the Los Angeles County board, the Times said.
"It's probably going to be Mr. Ascher if he's willing to accept our offer," Mel Wilson, one of Los Angeles Mayor Richard Riordan's appointees to the authority, told the Times.
